lines.t: (Verse 1)
When the night is long and silent,
When my soul feels far away,
Your whisper breaks the quiet—
“I was here, I never strayed.”
You said, “When you seek Me with all your heart,
You’ll find Me waiting there.”
So I’m running through the darkness,
Just to fall into Your care.
(Chorus)
For You are the One who loved me first,
Who bore the pain, broke every curse.
Yahushua, You rose again,
Now You live within my heart, my Friend.
I seek You with all my heart,
And I find You where love begins—
Right here, right now,
In the stillness within.
(Verse 2)
The tears become my worship,
The ache becomes my song,
Every beat of this heart remembers
You’ve been with me all along.
Like the disciples once You taught,
I will carry what You’ve done—
The cross, the grave, the morning light—
Forever, You and I are one.
(Chorus)
For You are the One who loved me first,
Who bore the pain, broke every curse.
Yahushua, You rose again,
Now You live within my heart, my Friend.
I seek You with all my heart,
And I find You where love begins—
Right here, right now,
In the stillness within.
(Bridge)
All my searching ends in You,
Every breath, a halleluYah.
I was lost, but Love broke through—
Now my heart belongs to Yah.
You are the One who loved me first,
Who bore the pain, broke every curse.
Yahushua, You rose again,
Now You live within my heart, my Friend.
I seek You with all my heart…
And I find You… I find You…
When I seek You with all my heart…
I find You.
